lines.zh: 我踩过天堂的草地，草不响。
lines.en: I cross Haven's grass, and the grass is silent.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，怕吵醒谁。
lines.en: My steps are light; I fear waking someone.

lines.zh: 光从我背上滑过去，像水。
lines.en: Light slides off my back like water.

lines.zh: 我沿着山坡走，走到哪儿都一样亮。
lines.en: I walk the slope, and it is equally bright everywhere.

lines.zh: 我身后留不下什么，只有压弯的草。
lines.en: I leave nothing behind but bent grass.

lines.zh: 白天很长，够我走很远。
lines.en: The day is long, long enough to walk far.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，因为我不赶时间。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 云影落在我身上，我停了一下。
lines.en: A cloud's shadow falls on me; I pause.

lines.zh: 我跟着一条小水沟走。
lines.en: I follow a small ditch as it goes.

lines.zh: 天堂的路都是软的，踩下去有回声。
lines.en: Haven's paths are soft and answer each step.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过花，花就直起来了。
lines.en: My tail brushes a flower, and it straightens.

lines.zh: 我走得比影子快一点。
lines.en: I walk a little faster than my shadow.

lines.zh: 远处有同伴，我朝那边拐。
lines.en: A companion is far off; I veer toward it.

lines.zh: 这片草地我走过三遍，还是新鲜。
lines.en: I have crossed this meadow thrice and it stays new.

lines.zh: 我踩过一片花，尽量不压坏。
lines.en: I cross the flowers, crushing few.

lines.zh: 山坡上的草短，我走得更快。
lines.en: Short grass on the slope lets me hurry.

lines.zh: 我站着，光就停在我身上不走。
lines.en: I stand still, and the light stays on me.

lines.zh: 我很温和，温和到没人怕我。
lines.en: I am gentle, so gentle no one fears me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，天堂的天没有边。
lines.en: I look up; Haven's sky has no edge.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛吹乱了，我不管。
lines.en: The wind tousles my coat; I let it.

lines.zh: 我嚼着一根草，嚼得很慢。
lines.en: I chew a blade of grass very slowly.

lines.zh: 有只虫落在我背上，我让它待着。
lines.en: A bug lands on my back; I let it stay.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，眼前还是亮的。
lines.en: I close my eyes, and it is still bright.

lines.zh: 二十三点的命，够我活很久。
lines.en: Twenty-three points of life; enough for a long while.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我叫起来太轻。
lines.en: I do not call out; my voice is too soft.

lines.zh: 旁边那棵树我认识，它比我老。
lines.en: I know that tree; it is older than I am.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，草刚好盖住我的腿。
lines.en: I crouch, and the grass just covers my legs.

lines.zh: 鼻子发痒，一声响把自己惊了。
lines.en: My nose tickles; the sneeze startles me.

lines.zh: 天堂里没有夜晚，我不用怕黑。
lines.en: Haven has no night, so I need not fear the dark.

lines.zh: 我只是在等太阳再高一点。
lines.en: I am only waiting for the sun to rise higher.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听远处的钟声。
lines.en: Head tilted, I hear a distant bell.

lines.zh: 影子短了，我知道快到正午。
lines.en: My shadow shrinks; noon is near.

lines.zh: 你从光里走过来，我以为你是同伴。
lines.en: You come out of the light; I took you for kin.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，又低头吃草。
lines.en: I glance up at you and go back to grazing.

lines.zh: 你的手里有东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: There is something in your hand; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我不躲，我从来没被人打过。
lines.en: I do not hide; no one has ever struck me.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就靠近两步。
lines.en: You crouch, and I take two steps closer.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，等你把话说完。
lines.en: I tilt my head and wait for you to finish.

lines.zh: 你的影子在地上，我踩了一脚。
lines.en: Your shadow lies on the ground; I step on it.

lines.zh: 你笑，我不知道你为什么笑。
lines.en: You laugh, and I do not know why.

lines.zh: 我身上亮，你会不会觉得刺眼。
lines.en: I glow; does it hurt your eyes?

lines.zh: 你站了很久，我陪你站。
lines.en: You stand a long time, so I stand with you.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子伸过去，碰了碰你的手。
lines.en: I reach my nose out and touch your hand.

lines.zh: 慢些走，我四只短腿追不上。
lines.en: Slow down; four short legs cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 你打我，我只是往后退。
lines.en: You strike me, and I only back away.

lines.zh: 疼，可我还是不跑。
lines.en: It hurts, yet I still do not run.

lines.zh: 我身上亮，血也亮。
lines.en: I glow, and so does my blood.

lines.zh: 这一下让我第一次学会怕。
lines.en: This blow teaches me fear for the first time.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，看不太懂。
lines.en: I look down at the wound and do not understand it.

lines.zh: 我没有还手，我只是让开。
lines.en: I did not strike back; I only made room.

lines.zh: 我喘得很响，草都听见了。
lines.en: My breathing is loud enough for the grass to hear.

lines.zh: 二十三点的命，掉了一点。
lines.en: Twenty-three points of life, one of them gone.

lines.zh: 我退到同伴那边去。
lines.en: I retreat toward my companions.

lines.zh: 我做错了什么，你偏要打我。
lines.en: What did I do wrong that you must strike me?

lines.zh: 你手里那把草，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: That grass in your hand is very clear to me.

lines.zh: 我不争，可我会一直跟着你。
lines.en: I will not fight for it, but I will follow you.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我走一步，很配合。
lines.en: You step, I step; we agree nicely.

lines.zh: 吃的在你那儿，我就朝你那儿。
lines.en: The food is with you, so I head your way.

lines.zh: 我闻着味道，口水都快流出来了。
lines.en: I smell it and nearly drool.

lines.zh: 你要是举高，我就踮脚。
lines.en: If you lift it, I rise on my toes.

lines.zh: 我吃过很多草，这种最香。
lines.en: I have eaten much grass; this smells best.

lines.zh: 你晃一下，我的头也跟着晃。
lines.en: You wave it, and my head waves along.

lines.zh: 别逗太久，我脾气好也会急。
lines.en: Do not tease too long; even I grow impatient.

lines.zh: 你把它放下，我就不追了。
lines.en: Set it down and I will stop following.

lines.zh: 吃饱了我就跟你并行，不乱跑。
lines.en: Once fed, I walk beside you and stray not.

lines.zh: 我从光里跑过来，就为了这一口。
lines.en: I run out of the light for this one bite.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，比我一天吃的都多。
lines.en: What you hold is more than I eat in a day.

lines.zh: 我拿鼻子拱你的手心。
lines.en: I nudge your palm with my nose.

lines.zh: 你手里那束草还在滴露水。
lines.en: The grass in your hand still drips.

lines.zh: 我一步一步凑近你的膝盖。
lines.en: Step by step I come to your knee.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我就往旁边让。
lines.en: You bump me, and I step aside.

lines.zh: 我的身子软，撞不出声音。
lines.en: My body is soft and makes no sound.

lines.zh: 别推我，我会以为你在玩。
lines.en: Do not shove me; I will think we are playing.

lines.zh: 我贴着你站，毛蹭到你的腿。
lines.en: I stand against you, coat brushing your leg.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我不生气。
lines.en: You step on my foot, and I am not angry.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，抬眼看你。
lines.en: I back half a step and look up at you.

lines.zh: 我这身毛很厚，撞起来不疼。
lines.en: My coat is thick; bumping me does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你挡着路，我就从旁边绕。
lines.en: You block the way, so I go around.

lines.zh: 两个挤在一起，光就更亮了。
lines.en: Two of us pressed together make the light brighter.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，是在打招呼。
lines.en: When I bump you, it is a greeting.

lines.zh: 我用头蹭它，它就懂了。
lines.en: I rub my head against it, and it understands.

lines.zh: 食物能让这件事更快一些。
lines.en: Food makes this happen sooner.

lines.zh: 我们并排走了一段，才停下来。
lines.en: We walk side by side a while before stopping.

lines.zh: 天堂里没有别的动物打扰我们。
lines.en: No other animal in Haven disturbs us.

lines.zh: 它的毛比我的暖一点。
lines.en: Its coat is a little warmer than mine.

lines.zh: 小的会跟着我们走，很吵。
lines.en: The young will follow us, quite noisily.

lines.zh: 我低下头，它也低下头。
lines.en: I lower my head, and it lowers its own.

lines.zh: 这件事很温和，和我一样。
lines.en: This is gentle, as I am.

lines.zh: 我们在最亮的地方做这件事。
lines.en: We do this in the brightest place.

lines.zh: 之后它去吃草了，我也去。
lines.en: Afterward it grazes, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我捡不起东西，我的嘴只够吃草。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; my mouth is for grass.

lines.zh: 有片叶子落在我鼻子上，我甩掉。
lines.en: A leaf lands on my nose; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼了一下，又放了。
lines.en: I take it in my mouth and let it go.

lines.zh: 那东西不香，我不想要。
lines.en: That thing does not smell good; I do not want it.

lines.zh: 我把它踢到一边，继续走。
lines.en: I kick it aside and keep walking.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的果子，我闻了闻就走。
lines.en: I sniff a fallen fruit and move on.

lines.zh: 蹄子只会踩，不会拿。
lines.en: Hooves are for standing, not for holding.

lines.zh: 有人掉了一朵花，我绕开了。
lines.en: Someone dropped a flower; I step around it.

lines.zh: 我咬着草，顺便带走一根树枝。
lines.en: Chewing grass, I carry off a twig as well.

lines.zh: 我不藏东西，饿了再找。
lines.en: I hoard nothing; I find food when hungry.

lines.zh: 有声音，我抬起头听。
lines.en: A sound comes; I lift my head to listen.

lines.zh: 我从不对谁起意，除非草在那儿。
lines.en: I never take interest in anyone unless grass is there.

lines.zh: 那影子很快，我往后退。
lines.en: That shadow moves fast; I back away.

lines.zh: 我看向响动的地方，只是看。
lines.en: I look toward the noise, and only look.

lines.zh: 天堂里没什么可怕的，我还没学会怕。
lines.en: Nothing in Haven is frightening; I have not learned fear.

lines.zh: 你走近，我就把你当同伴。
lines.en: As you come near, I take you for a companion.

lines.zh: 我耳朵转了半圈，锁住了那个声音。
lines.en: My ear turns half a circle and pins the sound.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，我不想过去。
lines.en: Something moves over there; I do not wish to go.

lines.zh: 我低头继续吃，装作没听见。
lines.en: I lower my head and graze as if I heard nothing.

lines.zh: 要我跑，得先有人吓我。
lines.en: For me to run, someone must first frighten me.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，蹄子在地上蹭。
lines.en: I stare at it, hoof scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 我不进攻，我只是不让它靠近。
lines.en: I do not attack; I only keep it from nearing.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的耳朵就跟着动。
lines.en: When it moves, my ears follow.

lines.zh: 我挡在小家伙前面。
lines.en: I stand in front of the little ones.

lines.zh: 我把自己站得直一点，显得大。
lines.en: I stand taller to look bigger.

lines.zh: 它从侧面来，我就侧身挡。
lines.en: When it comes at my flank, I turn to block.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里有一点声音，很轻。
lines.en: A small sound sits in my throat, very soft.

lines.zh: 我不叫，但我不退。
lines.en: I do not cry out, but I do not yield.

lines.zh: 它要是再近一步，我就顶它。
lines.en: One more step from it, and I will butt.

lines.zh: 这片草是我的，我吃得慢。
lines.en: This grass is mine; I eat it slowly.

lines.zh: 我低下头顶过去，力气不大。
lines.en: I lower my head and butt, without much force.

lines.zh: 我用前蹄刨了一下地，才冲。
lines.en: I paw the ground once before charging.

lines.zh: 撞上它，我自己也晃了。
lines.en: I hit it, and I stagger too.

lines.zh: 这一下更像推，不像打。
lines.en: This is more a push than a blow.

lines.zh: 我不咬，我只顶。
lines.en: I do not bite; I only butt.

lines.zh: 它一让，我便收蹄不追。
lines.en: The moment it yields, I rein in my hooves.

lines.zh: 我护着身后的小的，才动手。
lines.en: I strike only to guard the young behind me.

lines.zh: 我的力气都用在腿上。
lines.en: All my strength is in my legs.

lines.zh: 撞完我喘了两口气。
lines.en: After the hit I take two breaths.

lines.zh: 我不想伤谁，可我不能让路。
lines.en: I do not want to hurt anyone, but I cannot yield.

lines.zh: 天堂的草把我托起来，我睁眼。
lines.en: Haven's grass lifts me, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 光先照到我，我才有了形状。
lines.en: Light found me first, and then I had shape.

lines.zh: 周围很亮，我一点也不怕。
lines.en: It is bright around me, and I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 我的第一口，是脚边的草。
lines.en: My first mouthful is the grass at my feet.

lines.zh: 有一群同类在不远处，我走过去。
lines.en: A herd stands nearby; I walk toward it.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，把光抖开。
lines.en: I shake myself and scatter the light.

lines.zh: 天堂又多了个温和的东西。
lines.en: Haven has one more gentle thing.

lines.zh: 我出生时没有声音，很安静。
lines.en: I was born without a sound, quietly.

lines.zh: 草被我压出一个窝。
lines.en: The grass is pressed into a nest where I lie.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天上一片云都没有。
lines.en: I look up and there is not a cloud.

lines.zh: 火碰到我，我的毛卷了。
lines.en: Fire touches me, and my coat curls.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，滚得头晕。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and come up dizzy.

lines.zh: 水淹过我的鼻子，我慌了。
lines.en: Water crosses my nose, and I panic.

lines.zh: 响声太大，我趴在地上。
lines.en: The noise is too great; I lie flat.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我身上，很凉。
lines.en: Something pierces me, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 这味道让我打颤。
lines.en: This flavor makes me shiver.

lines.zh: 草吃完了，肚子在叫。
lines.en: The grass is gone, and my belly complains.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的毛全立起来了。
lines.en: Lightning falls, and my coat stands on end.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草地，我落不下去。
lines.en: The void has no grass, and I cannot land.
